Terms of use

How this site may be used, what it does not offer, and who owns the text.

The short answer

Read it, quote it with attribution, link to it freely. Do not present it as your own advice or as a professional opinion on someone's specific transaction.

What this site offers

A free, public, general explanation of how property purchase in China works for foreign nationals, organised as a decision framework. It is an editorial publication. It is not a service, a platform, a marketplace, an agency, a brokerage or an advisory practice.

Nothing on this site creates a client, advisory, fiduciary or professional relationship. No one here will act for you, negotiate for you, review a document for you or represent you.

Acceptable use

You may read, print, quote and redistribute the content for personal and non-commercial use, provided the source is attributed and the meaning is not changed. You may link to any page.

You may not:

  • Present the content as professional advice on a specific transaction
  • Reproduce substantial portions commercially without permission
  • Frame the site so that its origin is obscured
  • Use the content to market a property, a service or an investment product
  • Scrape it at a rate that degrades availability for other readers

Intellectual property

The text, structure, framework, calculators and design are the work of the site's author. The five-layer framework as presented here is original to this project. Quotation with attribution is welcome; republication in full is not.

No warranty

The content is provided as-is. Rules change, city practice varies, and figures are indicative ranges with a stated date. See the disclaimer for the full position on accuracy, liability and the absence of recommendations.

No money changes hands

The site has no company behind it, sells nothing, accepts no advertising, receives no commission, and does not handle money in any form — including deposits, escrow or transaction funds. If anyone claims to represent this site in a transaction, they do not.

Availability

The site is a static publication. It may be offline, and pages may be revised or removed without notice. There is no service-level commitment of any kind.

Changes

These terms may be revised as the site develops. The current version is the one published on this page.
